worker_output.summary: Completed ResearchScreen with full MOO1-accurate implementation. Left panel shows 6 field rows (COMPUTERS, CONSTRUCTION, FORCE FIELDS, PLANETOLOGY, PROPULSION, WEAPONRY) each with RP% allocation +/- buttons, current tech label, progress bar and ETA. Right panel is a scrollable tech tree browser for the selected field, organized by Level N separators with [✓]/[→]/[ ] state indicators. Bottom section has a description panel (click any tech to view) and a summary box (Total RP/turn + OK button). RP sliders always sum to 100% via proportional redistribution. Tech selection: hovering a [ ] tech reveals a 'Research' button that dispatches SET_RESEARCH_CURRENT_TECH to store. Extended ResearchState with optional fieldAllocation and fieldCurrentTech for per-field persistence. Added SET_RESEARCH_ALLOCATION and SET_RESEARCH_CURRENT_TECH reducer cases. All 1178 tests pass, typecheck clean.

design_gaps.section: Tech Selection Popup (Start of Turn Only)
design_gaps.notes: The wireframe specifies a separate full-screen modal for tech selection at start of turn. The ResearchScreen instead exposes a 'Research' button on [ ] tech rows (visible on hover) that dispatches SET_RESEARCH_CURRENT_TECH. This satisfies acceptance criterion #5 while deferring the separate popup to a future task.

design_gaps.gap: Per-field progress RP tracking in state
design_gaps.notes: ResearchState has a single researchPoints field (for legacy single-tech). Per-field progress accumulation via field turn processing is not yet implemented. ETAs in the UI are calculated from researchPoints for the primary tech, and 0 for secondary fields. Full per-field RP accumulation is a turn-processor concern (process_research_turn in systems/research.ts is ready).
